patch_description: This redesign uses an archive-based search architecture rather than repeatedly perturbing only one incumbent. It builds several input-derived C4-free repairs, saturates them with blocked-opportunity and degree-balance scoring, retains a small archive of diverse high-quality states, and launches structured delete/refill kicks from multiple archive members. All insertions are checked using the length-three-path criterion, and every major phase is explicitly validated with the common-neighbor invariant.
